tasks.title: Announcement #68
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a university event.
tasks.transcript: Attention, everyone. We are excited to announce that the University's annual Job Fair will take place next Wednesday from 10:00 a.m. to 4 p.m. in the Main Hall. This is a great opportunity to meet potential employers and explore career options. We hope to see you there.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?

options.D: A change in the event's location

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：We are excited to announce that the University‘s annual Job Fair will take place next Wednesday from 10:00 a.m. to 4 p.m. in the Main Hall. 选项分析： A. A networking event 一场社交活动。公告中提到的是招聘会（Job Fair），虽然包含社交成分，但主要性质是招聘会，所以A选项不够准确。 B. A career workshop 一场职业工作坊。公告中未提及工作坊，所以B选项错误。 C. An upcoming job fair 一场即将到来的招聘会。公告明确宣布年度招聘会的时间地点，所以C选项正确。 D. A change in the event‘s location 活动地点的变更。公告中未提及地点变更，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker hope the listeners will do?
questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：说话者希望听众做什么？ 定位原文：We hope to see you there. 选项分析： A. Visit the career center 去职业中心。公告中未提及职业中心，所以A选项错误。 B. Prepare for interviews 准备面试。公告中未明确要求准备面试，所以B选项错误。 C. Submit their résumés 提交简历。公告中未提及提交简历，所以C选项错误。 D. Attend the job fair 参加招聘会。说话者说“希望在那里见到你”，即希望听众到场参加招聘会，所以D选项正确。
